question: Reconciling claims from 2023 and 2025 against overseas per-diem: which two versions, and nightly lodging cap under each?

members.why: explains which per-diem version covers which date range
version in force until 2024-07-01, covers a 2023 claim; band-only lodging cap
version in force 2024-07-01 to 2025-12-31, covers a 2025 claim; lodging cap by grade and band
